topics.title: Tracing Democratic Traditions from Early Times
topics.ncert_sections: Tracing Democratic Traditions from Early Times

concepts.learning_objective: Identify early Indian institutions such as the Sabha, Samiti, ganas and Bauddha Samghas that reflected collective decision-making.
Explain how the Constituent Assembly framed a flexible Constitution that can be amended under Article 368.

topics.title: Principles of Democracy: Popular Sovereignty, Rule of Law and Fundamental Rights

concepts.learning_objective: Explain popular sovereignty and the Universal Adult Franchise as the basis of a government's authority.
Describe equality before law, equal protection of law and procedure established by law.
Identify the six Fundamental Rights, their Articles and the remedies under Articles 32 and 226.

topics.title: Separation of Powers, Accountability, Parties and Democratic Institutions
topics.ncert_sections: Principles of Democracy; Role of Media in Democracy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the separation of powers among the three organs creates checks and balances.
Describe how accountability mechanisms and a multi-party system make government answerable to people.
Match democratic processes with the institutions that support them, including the media as the fourth pillar.

topics.title: Types of Democracy around the World

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish direct democracy from representative democracy with examples.
Compare parliamentary and presidential systems using India, Canada, the UK, Switzerland and the USA.

topics.title: Democracy in Practice: India's Living Democracy
topics.ncert_sections: Democracy in Practice: India's Living Democracy

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret facts that show the scale and inclusiveness of Indian elections.
Explain how Panchayats, ADCs and the PESA Act enable participation at the grassroots.
Describe women's voting rights and reservation for women in local bodies.

topics.title: Challenges to Democratic Practices and Democracy and You
topics.ncert_sections: Challenges to Democratic Practices in India; Democracy and You

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse challenges such as misinformation, inequality and the Emergency of 1975-77.
Explain how informed and responsible citizens strengthen democracy.
